patchouli.book.name: Master's Guide to Culinary Arts
patchouli.landing_text: Welcome to the Master's Guide to Culinary Arts! In this guide, you'll learn how to become a Master of Culinary Arts!
patchouli.category.raw_material_collecti: The acquisition of raw materials in this mod is closely related to Archaeology. Understanding Vanilla's Archaeology system will make it easier to play this mod.
patchouli.entry.mod_seeds.name: How to obtain mod seeds
patchouli.entry.mod_seeds.pages.1.text: You may have already noticed some lone Blue Orchids in the Overworld. You need to craft a Brush, just like in Vanilla, and use it to sweep away the Suspicious Dirt buried beneath the Blue Orchids. This will grant you Soiled Seeds (Suspicious Dirt can also be found in the mod's structures).
patchouli.entry.mod_seeds.pages.2.text: You can place them in water or let them get rained on to wash out random mod seeds.
patchouli.entry.plant_rice.name: How to Plant Rice
patchouli.entry.plant_rice.pages.1.text: Plant rice on dirt with water above it. Once the rice is fully grown, use a hoe to harvest the upper part.
patchouli.entry.salt_pan.name: How to get salt
patchouli.entry.salt_pan.pages.1.text: Ensure the Salt Pan is exposed to the sky. Right-click the Salt Pan with a Water Bottle, and there will be a chance to generate salt during the day.
patchouli.entry.famous_dish_spices.name: How to obtain famous dish spices
patchouli.entry.famous_dish_spices.pages: In the Overworld, find a Greenhouse or Abandoned Farmland structure; famous dish spices can be found inside. They can also be copied via recipes.
patchouli.category.nutrient_system.name: Nutrient System
patchouli.category.nutrient_system.descr: Nutrient System Determines the Nutritional Value and Effects of Custom Food Items.
patchouli.entry.nutritional_values.name: How to View Nutritional Values
patchouli.entry.nutritional_values.pages: You can view the nutritional values, estimated Nutrition and Saturation values after crafting custom food, as well as the estimated Effects by pressing the left Ctrl or right Ctrl key. It’s important to note that these values will change based on the number of the current ItemStack you are pointing at.
patchouli.entry.effects_of_nutritional_v: Effects of Nutritional Values

Below are the effects provided by various nutrients or combinations of nutrients, as well as their functions. Nutrients marked with an asterisk (*) indicate Powerful Effects, those marked with a hashtag (#) will reduce the custom food’s Nutrition, and those marked with a dollar sign ($) will reduce the custom food’s Saturation.
Required: Cold$(br)This MobEffect can extinguish the fire on the entity when it is no longer in contact with a fire source.
Iced
Required: Warm$(br)This MobEffect allows the player to walk on powder snow.
Warm Stomach
Required: Ecology$(br)This MobEffect can increase the player's health regeneration speed, as well as movement speed, attack speed, max health, and attack damage.
*Vitality
Required: Dread$(br)This MobEffect can remove harmful effect from the entity and convert the harmful effect into health points.
*Antidote
Required: Nothingness$(br)This MobEffect allows the player to stay flying, but prevents them from landing.
*Soar
Required: Water and Protein | Water and Dietary Fiber$(br)This effect prevents Phantoms from spawning near the player and grants the Night Vision effect.
Noctenergy Surge
Required: Mineral and Vitamin and Dietary Fiber$(br)This MobEffect can increase the player's health regeneration speed, but it will slightly accelerate food consumption.
Metabolism
Required: Protein and Lipid and Carbohydrate$(br)This MobEffect can increase max health, attack damage, and grant damage resistance.
Robust
Required: Sour and Sweet$(br)This MobEffect grants the player the damage resistance effect upon activation and increases their maximum health.
$Vitality Restoration
Required: Bitter and Spicy$(br)This MobEffect can increase the player's attack speed, movement speed, and mining speed.
#Calorie Burn
Required: Salty and Numbing$(br)This MobEffect can enhance the entity's health regeneration.
#$Smooth Blood Flow
Required: Fresh and Fragrant$(br)This MobEffect can make the player luckier.
#Mental Stimulation
Required: Sour and Spicy$(br)This MobEffect can increase the player's damage.
#$Appetite Boost
Required: Sweet and Spicy$(br)This MobEffect can give the player the damage resistance effect.
#$Sustained Energy
Required: Bitter and Numbing$(br)This MobEffect can accelerate the player's health regeneration.
#$Stress Relief
Required: Fresh and Salty$(br)This MobEffect can give the player the Instant Heal effect. On top of that, it will also continuously grant the water breathing effect.
#$Hydration And Plumpness
patchouli.category.cooking.name: Cooking
patchouli.category.cooking.description: General Actions:$(br)Right-click on the container to place the item in your hand, and shift + right-click to take out all items.
patchouli.entry.brewing_barrel.name: Brewing Barrel
patchouli.entry.brewing_barrel.pages.1.t: When the items input match the correct recipe, the Brewing Barrel will start crafting. The crafting progress can be viewed through the Brewing Barrel's progress bar.
patchouli.entry.casserole.name: Casserole
patchouli.entry.casserole.pages.1.text: Use a Water Bucket and right-click to add water. Right-click a Casserole with a Casserole Lid to speed up cooking. Use a Spoon and right-click a Casserole without a lid to accelerate cooking. You can heat the Casserole by placing a heat source block underneath it.
patchouli.entry.soup_bowl.name: Soup Bowl
patchouli.entry.soup_bowl.pages.1.text: Right-click on the Casserole to retrieve the stew inside. Hold right-click to eat the stew. Shift + right-click on a regular block will place the Soup Bowl as a block, and right-click on the block to eat from it.
patchouli.category.famous_dishes.name: Famous Dishes
patchouli.category.famous_dishes.descrip: Famous Dish is a separate type of dish outside of custom foods.
patchouli.entry.crafting_a_famous_dish.p: Place the correct ingredients into the Casserole (don’t forget to add the Famous Dish Spice and the Famous Dish Plate!) to retrieve the Famous Dish.
patchouli.entry.eating_a_famous_dish.pag: The Famous Dish cannot be eaten directly. It must be placed as a block before it can be consumed.
